about: The release note draft for 0.2.1. Every line is checked by claim-seal against this version's changelog section on the maintainer's own computer before the tag (scripts/seal-release-note.sh); the result is committed as 0.2.1.sealed.json and the release workflow only re-verifies it offline (scripts/release/release_note.py).

items.insight: Adding a web page as a source no longer stalls on a hostile page that has one very long link tag.
The closing note of composer setup no longer promises an emailed brief that is not live; it now says the emailed brief from lensmith.ai is coming soon and not live yet.
The 0.2.0 note said you could get the daily brief by email from lensmith.ai with no setup. That was premature: no mail is sent yet.
